nodes.description: Public address state variable 'owner' recording the deployer/administrator address; used as the access-control authority for the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable that stores the most recent migration index; written by setCompleted and forwarded to freshly deployed Migrations instances in upgrade.
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the initial privileged account for the contract.
External, restricted function that writes the supplied value into last_completed_migration; guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
External, restricted function that instantiates a new Migrations contract from a caller-supplied address and delegates a state write to it.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership assignment and the require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check.
External call upgraded.setCompleted(last_completed_migration) to an attacker-influenceable address, executed without checks-effects-interactions ordering or a reentrancy guard.
External function argument 'completed' supplied by the caller of setCompleted; becomes the new migration index.
External function argument 'newAddress' supplied by the caller of upgrade; downcast to a Migrations contract and used as the external call target.
Local reference 'upgraded' holding the Migrations instance constructed from newAddress; the receiver of the delegated setCompleted call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable during construction, granting unconditional administrative rights to the deployer.
The restricted modifier requires msg.sender == owner, so the untrusted caller identity gates execution of setCompleted.
The restricted modifier requires msg.sender == owner, so the untrusted caller identity gates execution of upgrade.
owner is read by require(msg.sender == owner) to authorise setCompleted.
owner is read by require(msg.sender == owner) to authorise upgrade.
Parameter 'completed' flows into setCompleted as the value to persist.
Parameter 'newAddress' is used to construct the local Migrations instance 'upgraded'.
Local variable 'upgraded' becomes the callee of the external setCompleted invocation.
The current last_completed_migration value is read and passed into the external call after no state finalisation, enabling reentrant writes.
upgrade performs the external call to the attacker-influenceable Migrations instance.
The external call re-enters the untrusted contract's setCompleted, and any such target can switch back into this contract's state-changing paths while the call is in flight.

normalization_plan.reason: 'completed' is only meaningful as the sole argument of setCompleted and can be folded into that core function node.
'newAddress' exists solely as the input of upgrade and is subsumed by that core function node.
'upgraded' is a transient handle whose only purpose is to receive the external call, so it is absorbed by the unsafe external-call operation node.
